name: everyinfra-router
description: EveryInfra API router for data, search, AI, captcha, email, number and proxy workflows with live discovery.

interface.shortDescription: Route data, search, AI and agent infrastructure APIs
interface.longDescription: EveryInfra Router selects among structured data, web search, AI, authorized captcha, email, phone-number and proxy workflows, then checks the live MCP or REST contract before execution. It keeps discovery, account scopes and external actions separate.
defaultPrompt: I need public data about a set of businesses. Decide whether this is an EveryData or EverySearch task; inspect capabilities before proposing calls.
This request combines text classification and a proxy. Identify the required products and permission boundaries without placing an order.
Plan a workflow to find current product documentation and draft an email summary. Do not send the email or buy anything.
